command:

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
backup_dir=/var/backups/inventory

/usr/bin/flock -n 9 || exit 0

trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT

/usr/bin/tar -tzf "$tmp" >/dev/null
chmod 0600 "$tmp"

trap - EXIT
/usr/bin/find "$backup_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-????-??-??.tar.gz' -mtime +6 -delete
EOF
chmod 0750 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup

Description=Back up node2 inventory data to node1

Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup
User=root
Group=root
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=read-only
ReadWritePaths=/var/backups/inventory /run
EOF

Unit=inventory-backup.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF
